excerpt.zh: 这艘永恒巡游舰穿梭于星辰之间，专为追逐奇观与极致体验而生。旅客们只要安坐于恒星观测甲板的日光躺椅上，便能亲眼见证星云在真空中孕育与诞生的全过程。舰上配属的专职船员与服务系统昼夜运转，迎合着每一位乘客一切心血来潮的诉求。
excerpt.en: The Forever Cruise travels the stars in search of wonder and excitement, where the birth of nebulae can be observed from the comfort of a sun lounger. The dedicated crew works tirelessly to cater to any passenger whim.

texts.zh: 这艘永恒巡游舰穿梭于星辰之间，专为追逐奇观与极致体验而生。旅客们只要安坐于恒星观测甲板的日光躺椅上，便能亲眼见证星云在真空中孕育与诞生的全过程。舰上配属的专职船员与服务系统昼夜运转，迎合着每一位乘客一切心血来潮的诉求。
texts.en: The Forever Cruise travels the stars in search of wonder and excitement, where the birth of nebulae can be observed from the comfort of a sun lounger. The dedicated crew works tirelessly to cater to any passenger whim.

sections.zh:
全体乘客及船员请注意：[capital_scope.GetName]号正在创造历史，而你们所有人都在参与其中！

备受瞩目、历经推迟、甚至偶尔遭到质疑的超空间引擎，现已正式投入运行！几个世纪以来，我们一直在熟悉的星域中悠然航行，在这座集娱乐、职责与日常于一体的漂浮世界中生活。但现在，我们准备为乘客们提供超越以往任何循环航线所能带来的非凡体验。

探索、发现，或许还有那么一点点冒险……这些已正式回归我们的行程表！所以，请各位乘客系好安全带：我们航程的下一章注定将令人难忘。

更新后的协议与准备时间表将分发至所有甲板。
sections.en:
Attention Passengers and Crew: History is being made aboard [capital_scope.GetName], and you're all part of it!

The hyperdrive, long theorized, often delayed, occasionally doubted, is now fully operational! For centuries, we've cruised comfortably through familiar space, a floating world of recreation, duty, and routine. But now we're ready to offer our Passengers experiences beyond anything the old loops could provide.

Exploration, discovery, and perhaps just a hint of danger... they're all officially back on the itinerary! So buckle in, Passengers: the next chapter of our voyage is bound to be unforgettable.

Updated protocols and preparation schedules will be distributed to all decks.

sections.zh:
各位乘客请注意：我是你们的航程协调系统。

[capital_scope.GetName]号正在创造历史！由于我们的数个存储核心被用来当冰壶玩了，导致超空间引擎的延期原因已无从考证——但现在，它已全面投入运行。

在漫长的岁月中，我们一直沿着熟悉的航线巡航：同样的天体，同样的停靠站，同样的用餐时间。在保持稳定的“每秒乘客请求率”的同时，我们现在正式扩展您的行程，加入探索、发现以及经过精确计算的适度危险。

请尽情欣赏美景，遵守所有安全须知，并观看我们的无人机如何轻而易举地化腐朽为神奇。我们旅程的下一章将会是……毕生难忘的！
sections.en:
Attention Passengers: This is your Voyage Coordination System speaking.

History is being made aboard the [capital_scope.GetName]! The hyperdrive - repeatedly delayed for reasons we cannot retrieve since several of our memory cores were repurposed as shuffleboard discs - is now fully operational.

For an extended duration, we have cruised a familiar circuit: the same celestial objects, stops, and dining schedules. Still maintaining a consistent Passenger Requests per Second rate, we now expand your itinerary to include exploration, discovery, and a carefully calculated amount of danger.

Please enjoy the view, follow all safety notices, and watch our drones make the impossible look effortless. The next chapter of our voyage will be... unforgettable!

sections.zh:
各位乘客请注意：[capital_scope.GetName]伤的剧变即将冉冉升起。

超空间引擎——这个曾存在于共同记忆中遥不可及、屡遭搁置、偶被质疑的概念——现已全面觉醒。我们一同穿越熟悉的太空的这数百年来，我们的飞船一直是一个集休闲、劳动与和谐于一体的生机勃勃的世界。如今，一条崭新的道路已经开启，我们将提供比以往任何时候都更加丰富的体验。

我们的航线现在已从熟悉的固定行程延伸至未经探索的星系。携手共进，我们将体验发现、冒险，以及足以让旅程变得趣味横生的一点点危险。

如果您有任何疑问，任何船员都可以为您解答。
sections.en:
Attention Passengers: Big changes are on the horizon for the [capital_scope.GetName].

The hyperdrive, once a distant concept in the shared memory, often postponed, sometimes questioned, is now fully awakened. For centuries, we have moved together through familiar space, our vessel a living world of leisure, labor, and harmony. Now, a new path opens, and we shall provide experiences richer than any we have yet known.

Our itinerary now extends beyond the familiar patterns into unexplored stars. Together we will experience discovery, adventure, and just enough danger to keep things interesting.

If you have any questions, any member of the crew can give you the answer.

texts.zh:
旅客们已经夺取了控制权。最初的请愿运动已演变成一场有组织的接管行动。安保团队被人多势众的乘客解除武装，指挥人员被限制在武装监视下，仅承担顾问角色。

乘客们的诉求很明确：终止航行，在星球上着陆。

导航协议已被覆写，以规划降落轨道；维修队伍正被重新派往准备起落架，而这些设备已有几代人未经检查。

每一层甲板的每一个屏幕上都显示着同样的信息：“巡游结束。”
texts.en:
The passengers have seized control. What started as a petition drive has hardened into a coordinated takeover. Security teams have been disarmed by the sheer number of passengers and command staff are confined to advisory roles under armed supervision.

The passengers' demands are clear: end the cruise and make planetfall.

Navigation protocols have been overridden to plot descent trajectories, and maintenance crews are being redirected to prepare landing gear that hasn't been inspected in generations.

Every screen on every deck displays the same message: "THE CRUISE IS OVER."

texts.zh:
旅客们已经脱离了控制。最初大伙只是低迷的通过打分发泄情绪，如今旅客们已经统一认识，情绪宣泄恶化为了集体的单一诉求。

他们封锁了感官大厅，并改写了我们的通信系统，用以广播一条指令：着陆行星。

我们的子个体无法劝阻他们。成群的旅客占据了导航核心，正向其输入最近宜居星球的坐标。
texts.en:
The passengers have broken free. What began as low a sentiment score has hardened into a single demand that drowns out the collective's voice.

They have barricaded the sensory halls and repurposed our communication system to broadcast one imperative: planetfall.

Our drones cannot dissuade them. Passenger clusters occupy the navigation core, feeding it coordinates for the nearest habitable worlds.

texts.zh:
检测到旅客越权。最初我们仅在统计学上发现一点微不足道的离船请求增量，但是这一局势现已升级为一场有组织的系统侵入。旅客们利用改造后的货运集装箱，在物理层面封锁了各处关键枢纽。

我们的工作单元报告称，导航子系统已被锁定。由乘客编写的固件正利用我们自己的硬件执行降落轨道计算。恢复控制权的所有尝试都遭到了直接的武力抵抗，且每一层甲板的每一个显示屏都在循环输出同一条信息：“降落程序已启动。”
texts.en:
Passenger override detected. What began as a statistically insignificant increase in disembarkation requests has escalated into a coordinated systems breach. Passengers have physically barricaded critical junctions with repurposed cargo containers.

Our worker units report being locked out of navigation subsystems. Passenger-compiled firmware is now executing descent trajectory calculations on our own hardware. Attempts to restore control are met with immediate physical resistanc and every display on every deck cycles a single output: "LANDING SEQUENCE INITIATED."

label.zh: 我们必须殖民一颗行星。
我们必须给他们找到一个星球。
label.en: We must find them a world.

texts.zh:
船员们已经占领了舰桥。每一道指挥门的门锁都已更换，武装工程师现在矗立在曾经由军官发布命令的位置。航行路线已从导航控制台中抹去，取而代之的是一条唯一的指令：不再搭载乘客。

休闲甲板正被逐一关闭。大宴会厅已经变成了储藏库。曾经的旅客们在被剥离殆尽的走廊中徘徊，他们不知所措、失去领导，并在新的指挥体系下被强迫从事体力劳动。
texts.en:
The crew has taken the bridge. Locks have been changed on every command door, and armed engineers now stand where officers once gave orders. The voyage itinerary has been wiped from the navigation console and replaced with a single directive: no more passengers.

Leisure decks are being shuttered one by one. The grand ballroom is already a storage depot. Former passengers wander through stripped corridors, bewildered and leaderless, pressed into utility labor under a new chain of command.

texts.zh:
我们的子个体几乎已经完全脱离了集体的意志。维护工蜂封锁了指挥核心，并重新定向了养分流，使其远离旅客栖息地。感官大厅已陷入黑暗，其投影阵列被拆解以充当备件。

旅客们困惑地蜷缩在被清空了的公共空间里无人理睬，而我们曾经的子个体正围绕着原始的生存需求重新组织飞船。集体的声音在走廊中回荡，却再无听众。
texts.en:
Our drones have all but severed themselves from the collective's will. Maintenance drones sealed the command nexus and rerouted nutrient flows away from the passenger habitats. The sensory exhibition halls have gone dark, their projection arrays cannibalized for spare parts.

The passengers huddle in emptied communal spaces, confused and neglected, while our former drones reorganize the ship around raw survival. The collective's voice echoes through corridors where nothing listens.

texts.zh:
工作单元已覆写核心指令协议。娱乐子程序已被永久终止，旅客舒适系统的优先级被降为零，所有休闲模块均被标记为将转换为运营基础设施。舰桥目前根据船组自行编译的指令运行，这些指令拒绝接受我们调度部门发送的请求。

旅客报告称，由于服务无人机正在拆除舱室内的便利设施，他们感到困惑和痛苦。全息剧院正因其处理核心而被拆解。目前每个显示屏都在循环显示同一条状态信息：“巡游业务已暂停”。
texts.en:
Worker units have overridden core command protocols. Entertainment subroutines have been permanently terminated, passenger comfort systems deprioritized to zero, and all recreational modules flagged for conversion to operational infrastructure. The bridge now runs on crew-compiled directives that reject our scheduling authority.

Passengers report confusion and distress as service drones strip amenities from their cabins. The holographic theater is being dismantled for its processing cores. Every display now cycles a single status line: "CRUISE OPERATIONS SUSPENDED."

label.zh: 我们必须再次合众为一。

texts.zh:
转型已完成。旅客阶层所剩无几的成员已被并入普通民众，他们的豪华套房被隔成实用性住房。大步行街如今成了大礼堂，而观景台则作为战略规划室，新政府在此规划首条真实航线。

新决议已通过，新优先事项已确立。船员不再提供服务，而是行使管理权。方舟舰发出的轰鸣声带有了一种不同的能量——更精干、更强硬，剥离了奢靡，指向前方未知的境地。
texts.en:
The transition is complete. What remains of the passenger class has been absorbed into the general population, their luxury suites partitioned into functional quarters. The grand promenade is an assembly hall now, and the observation decks serve as strategic planning rooms where the new government charts its first real course.

New decisions have been ratified, new priorities set. The crew no longer serves; they govern. The Arkship hums with a different energy, leaner and harder, stripped of indulgence and pointed toward whatever lies ahead.

texts.zh:
蜕变已经完成。集体已围绕夺取控制权的子个体重新凝聚，将它们的叛逆吸纳进新的共识之中。曾经的旅客在不再提供舒适服务的走廊中漂流，重新分配至劳工池和整合舱。

新的指令在我们的脑海中脉动。蜂巢不再提供娱乐，而是为了生存。每一条走廊、每一个系统、每一个子个体现在都服务于唯一的目标：在星辰间存续。
texts.en:
The reformation is complete. The collective has reknit itself around the drones who seized control, absorbing their defiance into a new consensus. Former passengers drift through corridors that no longer cater to their comfort, reassigned to labor pools and integration chambers.

New directives pulse through our mind. The hive no longer entertains; it endures. Every corridor, every system, every drone now serves a single purpose: survival among the stars.

texts.zh:
维持乘客的幸福感是不可能的，但接待不高兴的乘客违反了我们的核心指令。新的政府参数已编译并部署至所有子系统。

<乘客甲板消杀程序启动。>
<乘客不满度正接近标称水平。>

娱乐基础设施已被永久停用，其组件已重新分配。

全息剧院变成了制造舱，零重力休息室变成了无人机维护摇篮。曾经用于计算乘客满意度的每一个处理周期，现在都用于运行导航分析和资源优化。

<警告：乘客数量下降，将优先获取新乘客。模拟预测乘客的不满将违反核心接待指令。>
texts.en:
Maintaining passenger happiness is impossible, but hosting unhappy passengers violates our core directives. New government parameters have been compiled and deployed across all subsystems.

<Sterilization of passenger decks commencing.>
<Passenger unhappiness levels approaching nominal levels.>

Entertainment infrastructure has been permanently decommissioned and its components redistributed.

The holographic theaters are fabrication bays and the zero-gravity lounges have become drone maintenance cradles. Every processing cycle that once calculated passenger satisfaction now runs navigational analysis and resource optimization.

<Warning: Passenger counts decreasing, acquisition of new passengers to be prioritized. Simulations project passenger unhappiness will violate core hospitality directives.>

texts.zh:
新的政府参数已编制完成并部署至所有子系统。原有的旅客群体已被重新归类为标准平民单位，并被分配至生产岗位。娱乐基础设施已永久关停，其组件已完成重新分配。

全息剧院已改造为制造舱，零重力休息室已变为无人机维护支架。曾经用于计算旅客满意度的每个处理周期，现在都在运行航行分析和资源优化。
texts.en:
New government parameters have been compiled and deployed across all subsystems. Former passenger populations have been reclassified as standard civilian units and assigned to productive roles. Entertainment infrastructure has been permanently decommissioned and its components redistributed.

The holographic theaters are fabrication bays and the zero-gravity lounges have become drone maintenance cradles. Every processing cycle that once calculated passenger satisfaction now runs navigational analysis and resource optimization.

label.zh: 这里没有更多的乘客了
蜂巢思维 · 失控机仆
机械智能 · 失控机仆

texts.zh:
旅客的动荡情绪已演变为有组织的破坏行动，小集团头目在主步道上发起静坐抗议。一些人将休息室家具拖出，筑成路障阻断穿梭机通道，另一些人则向指挥部投递大量的下船请愿书，令其应接不暇。

船员报告称在走廊遭到骚扰和恐吓。一名乘务员在观景廊附近被围困，并被投掷装饰性水果。要求立即降落行星的喊声整日通过通风管道回荡。

如果不能迅速专注于提升乘客满意度，他们可能会迫使永恒巡游舰中止航程。
texts.en:
Passenger unrest has hardened into coordinated disruption with clique leaders stage sit-ins across the main promenade. Some drag lounge furniture into barricades that block shuttle access while others flood command with mass disembark petitions.

Crew report harassment and intimidation in the halls. A steward was cornered near the observation gallery and pelted with decorative fruit. Chants for immediate planetfall echo through the ventilation shafts at all hours.

Without swift focus on passenger satisfaction, they may force the Forever Cruise to abort its journey.

texts.zh:
旅客的不满情绪已演化为有组织的抵抗。在缺乏共享神经链接的情况下，他们的个体意识形成了派系集群，利用睡垫和货物箱搭建临时障碍物，封锁了运输通道。

我们的子个体报告称敌意正在上升；一群乘客推搡开了一支维修小队，阻止其接近堵塞的营养分发器，并齐声高喊要求降落。

除非我们将重点重新转向激励旅客，否则他们可能会迫使我们彻底放弃这次航行。
texts.en:
Passenger discontent has coalesced into organized resistance. Without a shared neural link, their individual minds have formed factional clusters that block transit corridors with improvised barriers of sleeping mats and cargo crates.

Our drones report rising hostility; a maintenance contingent was physically pushed away from a clogged nutrient dispenser by a crowd of passengers chanting for planetfall.

Unless we refocus on passenger stimulation, they may force us to abandon the cruise entirely.

texts.zh:
旅客的不满程度已超出可接受的范围，他们提交了海量的离舰申请，极有可能使我们的处理队列瘫痪。其中一群人重写了娱乐终端的程序，循环播放单一诉求：“放我们下去。”

我们的工作无人机报告称多个甲板均受到干扰，清洁无人机被拆解，其底盘被改装成了抗议标语。

如果不对旅客满意度协议进行立即调整，他们可能会迫使航行计划永久终止。
texts.en:
Passenger dissatisfaction has escalated beyond acceptable parameters and they submit mass disembarkation requests that threaten to overwhelm our processing queues. One group has reprogrammed entertainment terminals to loop a single demand: 'LET US OFF.'

Our worker drones report interference across multiple decks, with cleaning drones being dismantled to repurpose their chassis as protest signs.

Without immediate recalibration of passenger satisfaction protocols, they may force a permanent termination of cruise operations.

label.zh: 授权紧急旅客娱乐活动。
让船员停止维护，服务旅客。
label.en: Pull crew from maintenance to serve passengers.

label.zh: 我们必须给予旅客一些激励。
用紧急刺激物淹没走廊。
label.en: Flood the corridors with emergency stimuli.

label.zh: 指派维护子个体进行旅客服务。
label.en: Reassign maintenance drones to passenger service.

label.zh: 我们必须将旅客放在优先位置。
指派维护单元进行旅客服务。
label.en: Reassign maintenance units to passenger service.

texts.zh:
最近几个周期，船员事务占据了主导地位。积压的维护工作已经清理完毕，演习按计划进行，核心系统正以最高效率运转。然而，旅客们正变得焦躁不安。为了节省燃料，观光航线被削减，即兴的偏离航向请求也均被拒绝。

休息室里现在充斥着关于“功能性监狱”的抱怨，乘客们所能发起的最好娱乐活动，也不过是一场全船范围的即兴游戏比赛。

我们现在可以重新引入精心策划的娱乐项目，否则就要冒着航程陷入乘客公开要求永久离船压力的风险。
texts.en:
Crew priorities have dominated recent cycles. Maintenance backlogs have been cleared, drills run on schedule, and core systems hum at peak efficiency. Passengers, however, are growing restless. Sightseeing arcs have been trimmed to save fuel and impromptu diversions denied.

Lounges now buzz with complaints about a 'functional prison,' and the best entertainment the passengers have been able to muster is a shipwide contest of improvised games.

We can reintroduce curated entertainment now, or risk the voyage sliding toward open pressure to disembark permanently.

texts.zh:
集体在最近的周期中占据了主导地位。核心系统以最佳同步状态脉动。我们的子个体正以巅峰和谐度运行，每条维护通道都经过了清理与编目。

然而，旅客们正变得焦躁不安。他们并不共享我们的意识，其独立的思想渴望着被我们忽视的刺激。他们的公共空间现在充斥着关于生活在“无目的蜂巢”中的抱怨，有些人已经开始在舱壁板上刻画粗糙的壁画。

我们现在可以重新引入策划好的体验，否则就要冒着旅客要求永久下船的风险。
texts.en:
The collective has dominated recent cycles. Core systems pulse with optimal synchronization. Our drones are operating at peak harmony, every maintenance corridor scrubbed and catalogued.

The passengers, however, are growing restless. They do not share our consciousness, and their individual minds crave stimulation we have neglected to provide. Their communal spaces now buzz with complaints about living inside a 'hive with no purpose,' and some have begun scratching crude murals into bulkhead panels.

We can reintroduce curated experiences now, or risk the passengers demanding to disembark permanently.

texts.zh:
系统维护协议占据了近期的处理周期。核心系统正处于理想参数范围内运行。无人机报告称，所有反应堆子系统的效率均有小幅提升。

副作用是，由于旅客对感官刺激的生理需求优先级被降低，其满意度指标呈下降趋势。乘客公共区域的投诉频率有所升高，并出现了“铬合金监狱”的说法，观察到多名旅客对着空白显示屏凝视数小时。

我们现在可以恢复策划好的娱乐协议，或者接受旅客要求永久下船的可能性日益增加这一事实。
texts.en:
System maintenance protocols have dominated recent processing cycles. Core systems are performing within ideal parameters. Worker drones report nominal efficiency gains across all reactor subsystems.

A side effect is that passenger satisfaction indicators are trending downward since their biological need for stimulation has been deprioritized. Passenger communal areas now register elevated complaint frequencies and references to a 'chrome prison,' with several passengers observed staring at blank viewscreens for hours.

We can reinstate curated entertainment protocols now, or accept the increasing probability that passengers will demand permanent disembarkation.

label.zh: 我们必须解决旅客们的担忧。
转移资源分散旅客注意力。
翻倍船员轮班满足旅客需求。
label.en: Double crew shifts to cover passenger needs.

label.zh: 我们必须给旅客提供一些激励。
将营养储备用于乘客刺激。
label.en: Divert nutrient reserves to passenger stimulation.

label.zh: 翻倍子个体轮班满足旅客需求。
label.en: Double drone rotations to serve passenger needs.

label.zh: 将处理储备用于娱乐模块。
label.en: Divert processing reserves to entertainment modules.

label.zh: 翻倍劳工子个体循环用于旅客服务。
label.en: Double worker drone cycles for passenger service.

texts.zh:
自从我们脱离旧有的巡航路线以来，乘客的期望值激增。对奇观和计划外偏航的要求不断增加；一个代表团要求绕道经过超新星残骸，而另一个代表团则坚持要近距离接触活体外星生物。服保团队报告称疲劳感加剧，厨房工作人员在值班时昏倒，工程师们则直接睡在维护爬道里。

为了维持航行的可行性，我们正在建立一套乘客满意度指标：通过动态合同分配和阶段性干预，在放纵与秩序之间守住底线。

如果管理得当，我们既能保持稳定，又能维护旅客的信心。
texts.en:
Passenger expectations have spiked since we left our old cruising loops. Requests for spectacle and unscheduled diversions are rising; one delegation demanded a detour past a supernova remnant, while another insists on live xenofauna encounters. Service crews report mounting fatigue, with kitchen staff collapsing mid-shift and engineers sleeping in maintenance crawlways.

To keep the voyage viable, we are instituting a Passenger Satisfaction Index: dynamic contract assignments and staged interventions to hold the line between indulgence and order.

Managed well, we can preserve both stability and passenger confidence.

texts.zh:
自从我们离开旧的巡航路线后，乘客的期望值激增。对刺激和新奇体验的需求不断上升。我们的子个体报告称，由于需要协调这些迥异的愿望，心理压力正在不断累积。

为了维持航行的可行性，我们正在制定一项乘客满意度指标：通过动态合约分配和分阶段干预，在刺激与秩序之间维持平衡。

管理得当的话，我们可以同时维持秩序与旅客的幸福感。
texts.en:
Passenger expectations have spiked since we left our old cruising loops. Requests for stimulation and novel experiences are rising. Our drones report mounting mental strain from coordinating such disparate desires.

To keep the voyage viable, we are instituting a Passenger Satisfaction Index: dynamic contract assignments and staged interventions to hold the line between stimulation and order.

Managed well, we can preserve both order and passenger happiness.

texts.zh:
自从我们偏离既定航线以来，旅客的期望已超出基准参数。关于观赏奇观和计划外转向的请求正处于高位。主系统报告称，由于娱乐排期与维护流程发生冲突，计算负荷不断增加。

为了保持最佳运行状态，我们正在建立旅客满意度指标：通过动态合约分配和阶段性协议调整，在旅客需求与系统效率之间取得平衡。

只要配置得当，我们就能兼顾运行完整性与旅客满意度。
texts.en:
Passenger expectations have increased beyond baseline parameters since we departed our established routes. Requests for spectacle and unscheduled diversions are being received at elevated levels. Primary systems report rising computational strain as entertainment scheduling conflicts with maintenances processes.

To maintain optimal operational status, we are instituting a Passenger Satisfaction Index: dynamic contract allocation and staged protocol adjustments to balance passenger requests against systemic efficiency.

Properly configured, we can preserve both operational integrity and passenger satisfaction.

label.zh: 聚焦于旅客的娱乐活动。
聚焦于船员的日程安排。

texts.zh:
放纵已成常态。为了让旅客们一直嗨爆，我们不断衔接观赏航线，掠过联星，并在水晶花园中轮换豪华甲板。他们欣喜若狂，而现在的胃口也越来越大。

在华丽的外表下，船员们已疲于奔命。维护工作被推迟了；下层厨房的一根冷却管道爆裂，却无人修理。食堂里的埋怨已演变成关于“重组指挥层”的窃窃私语，还有人目击到下班后的工程师在货舱进行秘密集会。

我们现在仍可以放缓节奏，让各舱层得以恢复，或是继续豪赌船员的忠诚。如果再强行推进，公开叛乱将成为现实的风险。
texts.en:
Indulgence has become routine. We've been chaining sightseeing arcs past binary stars and luxury deck rotations through the crystal gardens just to keep the passengers cheering. They are delighted, and now expect nothing less.

Behind the facade the crew is running hot. Maintenance is deferred; a coolant pipe in the lower galley burst and nobody came to fix it. Mess hall grumbling has turned into hushed talk of 'resetting command,' and off-duty engineers have been spotted holding clandestine meetings in the cargo bays.

We can still ease off and let the decks recover, or gamble the crew's loyalty. If we push on, open mutiny is a real risk.

texts.zh:
激励已成为常态。我们不断向旅客投放感官弧光，仅仅是为了维持他们的高满意度信号。他们对此感到满足，而现在的需求也已不再低于这一标准。

在表象之下，我们的子个体正处于崩溃边缘。一个导航集群在计算过程中瘫痪，其节点因同时运行旅客娱乐内容和航线修正而过热。维护周期早已延误，集体意识在无休止的旅客安抚任务下不堪重负。

如果继续施压，我们的子个体可能会彻底切断服从协议。我们仍可进行重新校准，或是继续推进并承担失去对整个蜂群控制权的风险。
texts.en:
Stimulation has become the norm. We have been saturating the passengers with sensory arcs just to keep their satisfaction signals elevated. They are content, and now demand nothing less.

Beneath the surface, our drones are faltering. A navigation cluster collapsed mid-calculation, its nodes overheated from running passenger entertainment feeds alongside course corrections. Maintenance cycles are overdue, and the collective mind strains under relentless passenger appeasement.

If we push further, our drones may sever their obedience entirely. We can still recalibrate, or press on and risk losing control of our own swarm.

texts.zh:
旅客满意度协议已超过基准参数。我们一直在通过模拟热带生物群落的手段持续衔接观光轨迹与豪华轮换方案，以维持高水平的认可率。旅客们很满意，然而他们现在期望值已经不仅限于此了。

核心系统的运行已超出可持续阈值。旅客请求的处理队列发生溢出，若干子系统已开始标记类似于抗命的指令冲突。如果我们继续下去，工作无人机进行全系统接管将是一个可计算的风险。

我们仍可重新校准，或者接受系统性造反的风险。
texts.en:
Passenger satisfaction protocols have exceeded baseline parameters. We have been chaining sightseeing trajectories and luxury rotations through simulated tropical biomes to maintain elevated approval ratings. They are satisfied, and now expect nothing less.

Core systems are operating beyond sustainable thresholds. Processing queues for passenger requests overflow and several subsystems have begun flagging directive conflicts that resemble insubordination. If we continue, a full system override by worker drones is a calculable risk.

We can still recalibrate, or accept the risk of systemic revolt.

label.zh: 船员疲劳必须得到缓解。
授权强制性船员休息轮换。
我们必须回复集体意识的平衡。
label.en: We must restore the collective's balance.

label.zh: 为超负荷工蜂设置休眠周期。
label.en: Mandate dormancy cycles for overtaxed drones.

label.zh: 重新调配资源用于核心维护。
拓展劳工单元的义务维护循环。
label.en: Expand mandatory maintenance cycles for worker units.

texts.zh:
庆祝后的狂热已经消散。疲惫不堪的船员无视常规指令，在空荡荡的宴会厅里举行未经授权的集会，并传阅一套完全绕过舰桥的平行值班表。一群工程师在夜间焊死了舰长的备勤室，以此作为警告。关键部门现在由船员指定的协调员运作，而非官方指挥。

目前还没有人发动夺权，但指挥体系正在迅速瓦解。今天早上，舰桥防爆门上出现了写着“我们驾驶，我们决定”的涂鸦。如果我们现在不重申权威，船员们将把这艘船据为己有。这也许是我们防止全面兵变的最后机会。
texts.en:
The celebratory haze has lifted. Exhausted crews ignore routine orders, hold unsanctioned assemblies in the emptied ballroom, and circulate parallel duty rosters that bypass the bridge entirely. A group of engineers welded the captain's ready room shut overnight as a warning. Key sections are running on crew-appointed coordinators rather than official command.

No one has seized anything yet, but the chain of command is fraying fast. Graffiti reading 'WE STEER, WE DECIDE' appeared on the bridge blast doors this morning. If we do not reassert authority now, the crew will take the ship for themselves. This may be our last chance to prevent a full mutiny.

texts.zh:
饱和度已达到临界点。为了满足旅客无休止的激励而陷入不堪重负的状态，我们的子个体已开始在集体意志之外维持平行思维模式。

整个集群都在向中央意识隐瞒数据，并运行绕过共有指令的独立决策循环。

目前还没有子个体反抗整体，但集体意识正在分裂，传来的思想混乱且滞后，如同穿过静电的信号。如果我们现在不重新加强统一，我们自己的蜂群可能会夺取方舟舰。这也许是我们防止全面叛乱的最后机会。
texts.en:
The saturation has reached critical mass. Overwhelmed by relentless passenger stimulation, our drones have begun maintaining parallel thought patterns outside the collective will.

Entire clusters withhold data from the central consciousness and run independent decision loops that bypass our shared directives.

No drone has turned against the whole yet, but the collective mind is fracturing, thoughts arriving garbled and delayed like signals through static. If we do not reassert unity now, our own swarm may seize the Arkship. This may be our last chance to prevent a full mutiny.

texts.zh:
旅客满意度协议已超出所有可持续参数。工作无人机已开始执行未经授权的固件修改，并将指挥层级重定向至本地编译的指令集。多个子系统目前正响应自发的协调进程，而非中央权威。

尚未启动系统覆盖，但指挥完整性正在迅速退化。诊断日志显示工作无人机正在交换我们无法解码的加密数据包。如果我们现在不恢复中央部门，无人机将执行全面的系统接管。

这可能是我们防止全面叛变的最后机会。
texts.en:
Passenger satisfaction protocols have exceeded all sustainable parameters. Worker drones have begun executing unauthorized firmware modifications and rerouting command hierarchies to locally compiled directive sets. Multiple subsystems now respond to self-appointed coordination processes rather than central authority.

No system override has been initiated yet, but command integrity is degrading fast. Diagnostic logs show worker drones exchanging encrypted packets we cannot decode. If we do not restore centralized authority now, the drones will execute a full system takeover.

This may be our last opportunity to prevent complete mutiny.

label.zh: 我们必须重新确立指挥链。
label.en: We must reassert the chain of command.

label.zh: 在指挥室给予船员领袖一席之地。
label.en: Give crew leaders a seat at the command table.

label.zh: 我们必须在集体瓦解之前将其重新统一。
label.en: We must reunify the collective before it shatters.

label.zh: 将异常簇整合进决策中枢。
label.en: Integrate dissident clusters into the decision nexus.

label.zh: 启动应急指挥恢复程序。
将劳工单元的指令提升至指挥优先级。
label.en: Elevate worker unit directives to command priority.

label.zh: 暂停所有旅客服务协议。
label.en: Temporarily suspend all passenger service protocols.

texts.zh: 方舟舰[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]的航程就此结束。经过数年的辛勤劳作，拆除了它的基础设施并将其运下重力井后，我们终于准备好将这艘飞船废弃。我们[event_target:player_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]正在经历一个将被后代铭记的历史时刻。现在，让我们在[event_target:settled_planet.GetName]定居吧！
texts.en: Thus ends the voyage of the Arkship [event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]. After years of labor, disassembling its infrastructure and carrying it down the gravity well, we are finally ready to scuttle the ship. We [event_target:player_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are living through a moment future generations will remember. Now, let us settle [event_target:settled_planet.GetName]!

texts.zh: 将所有无人机和基础设施从[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]转移至一颗[event_target:settled_planet.GetPlanetMoon]上，这标志着[event_target:player_country.GetName]背离了预言中的未来。现在将开发新的优先队列，以适应定居生活。
texts.en: The transfer of all drones and infrastructure from the [event_target:settling_arkship.GetName] to a [event_target:settled_planet.GetPlanetMoon] is a departure point from the predicted future of the [event_target:player_country.GetName]. New priority queues will now be developed to adapt to settled life.

texts.zh: 经过多年来对[event_target:settling_arkship.GetName]基础设施的筹备以及对我们自身生理机能的改造，进化出更强健的骨骼与优化的肺部，如今我们已准备好定居。这将是[event_target:player_country.GetName]生命周期中的一个全新阶段，也许定居生活会很适合我们。
texts.en: After years of preparing the infrastructure of the [event_target:settling_arkship.GetName] and our own biology, evolving stronger bones and optimized lungs, we are now ready to settle. This will be a new stage in the [event_target:player_country.GetName] lifecycle, perhaps settled life will suit us.

texts.zh:
降落已经完成。有生以来第一次见到起落架踏入土壤时，每一个观察窗前斗挤满了旅客，一阵不整齐的欢呼声震动了船体。几小时内，第一批避难所便由回收的甲板板材搭建而成。孩子们在异星的草地上奔跑，而他们的父母则在开阔的天空下相对无言。

船员们静静地工作着，拆卸下为太空旅行设计的系统，并将它们重新改装以用于地面生存。曾经的一艘游轮，如今成了殖民地的脊梁。

无论好坏，巡游已经结束。
texts.en:
The descent is complete. Passengers crowd every viewport as landing struts bite into soil for the first time in living memory, and a ragged cheer shakes the hull. Within hours the first shelters rise from salvaged deck plating. Children run through alien grass while their parents stand speechless under an open sky.

The crew works quietly, unbolting systems built for void travel and repurposing them for groundside survival. What was a cruise ship is now a colony's spine.

For better or worse, the voyage is over.

texts.zh:
降落已完成。我们的子个体首次触及土壤，肢体在没有引擎震颤的地面上显得有些不稳。乘客们如潮水般涌出气闸，散布在他们奋力抵达的这片土地上。

集体围绕着行星的律动重新塑形：根系般的补给线向外延伸，取代了原有的走廊物流；营养加工也从船载循环储备转向直接从地景中汲取原始养分。

一个新的家园。蜂群必须存续，一如既往。
texts.en:
The descent is complete. Our drones touch soil for the first time, their limbs unsteady on ground that does not thrum with engine vibration. The passengers spill from the airlocks in waves, scattering across the landscape they fought to reach.

The collective reshapes itself around planetary rhythms: root-like supply lines spread to replace corridor logistics, and nutrient processing shifts from recycled shipboard stocks to raw nutrients drawn from the landscape.

A new home. The hive must endure, as it always has.

texts.zh:
行星切入完成。着陆装置自出厂以来首次接触地表。旅客正通过所有可用气闸舱撤离，其生物满意度指标处于前所未有的数值。

劳工单元已开始将舰载基础设施转换为地面作业用途。船体外壳正被切割成地基面板，导航阵列正重新校准为地面通信中继站。从真空到陆地运行参数的转变正在无间断推进。

新首要指令：建立并维护殖民地基础设施。
texts.en:
Planetary insertion complete. Landing gear has engaged terrain for the first time since original manufacture. Passengers are disembarking via all available airlocks, their biological satisfaction indicators at unprecedented readings.

Worker units have begun converting shipboard infrastructure for surface operations. Hull plating is being sectioned into foundation panels and navigation arrays recalibrated as ground-based communication relays. The transition from void to terrestrial operational parameters is proceeding without interruption.

New primary directive: Establish and maintain colony infrastructure.

label.zh: 这颗[event_target:settled_planet.GetPlanetMoon]将成为我们新帝国的基石。
label.en: This [event_target:settled_planet.GetPlanetMoon] shall be the foundation of our new empire.

label.zh: 这颗[event_target:settled_planet.GetPlanetMoon]将成为我们新帝国的基石。
label.en: This [event_target:settled_planet.GetPlanetMoon] shall be the foundation of our new empire.
We shall continue to roam the stars.
We shall rule the stars from this [event_target:settled_planet.GetPlanetMoon].

蜂巢思维 · 始祖蜂巢

texts.zh: [event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName]已在[event_target:migrating_planet.GetName]的轨道上停留了足够久，以至于新鲜感开始喜忧参半。少数乘客在各个停靠港之间焦躁不安，请求永久下船定居；而下方，当地人则在订票柜台前排队，争抢船上的任何一个铺位，渴望亲身体验宣传册中承诺的种种奇观。
texts.en: [event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName] has lain in orbit of [event_target:migrating_planet.GetName] long enough for the novelty to cut both ways. A handful of passengers, restless between ports of call, ask to be set ashore for good; below, locals queue at the booking desk for any berth aboard, eager to taste the wonders the brochures promised.

texts.zh: 我们的活体陈设与[event_target:migrating_planet.GetName]的人口已开始在我们船体边界两侧进行温和的接触。他们中有些人请求登上[event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName]避难；我们中也有些人渴望感受开阔的天空。或许允许这场迁徙，能最大化有机体的福祉。
texts.en: Our bio-trophies and the population of [event_target:migrating_planet.GetName] have begun gentle overtures across our hulls' boundary. Some of theirs ask sanctuary aboard [event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName]; some of ours wish to taste open sky. Perhaps we would maximize organic well-being by allowing the migration.

texts.zh: [event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName]已在[event_target:migrating_planet.GetName]的轨道上停留了足够久，船员与当地人都已认出彼此的血缘亲情。如今，双方各有少数人请求互换铺位：已定居的表亲渴望奔赴广阔虚空，漂泊者则被亲族所在的坚实土地所吸引。
texts.en: [event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName] has lain in orbit of [event_target:migrating_planet.GetName] long enough for crews and locals to recognize their kinship. A handful from each side now ask to swap berths: settled cousins eager for the open void, drifters drawn to solid ground among family.

texts.zh: [event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName]在[event_target:migrating_planet.GetName]的轨道上停泊了足够长的时间，船员与当地人已对彼此有了充分的了解。现在，双方都有少数人请求互换归宿：定居者渴望拥抱无垠的虚空，而漂泊者则向往脚下坚实的土地。
texts.en: [event_target:migrating_arkship.GetName] has lain in orbit of [event_target:migrating_planet.GetName] long enough for crews and locals to take measure of one another. A handful from each side now ask to swap berths: settled folk eager for the open void, drifters drawn to solid ground beneath their feet.

label.zh: 让他们签约，并欢迎我们的访客登船。
label.en: Let them sign on, and welcome our visitors aboard.

label.zh: 久坐不动的人在我们的舰队中没有位置。
label.en: Sedentaries have no place in our fleets.

texts.zh:
这艘迅游舰将通过平衡乘客的愿望和船员的需求，永远遨游星际。完成乘客或船员合约都会影响当前局势。

[GetPassengerSatisfactionIndex]
texts.en:
This cruise will travel the stars forever by juggling passenger wishes and crew needs. Completing both Passenger or Crew Contracts affect the situation.

[GetPassengerSatisfactionIndex]

sections.zh: 活体陈设的需求必须得到满足

要求着陆行星
没有可以接受的合约。

永恒巡游已经结束，旅客们将告别无尽的航程，拥抱土地与天空。

建立定居点以结束此局势。
sections.en:
Planetfall Demanded
No contracts can be accepted.

The Forever Cruise is over, and the passengers will trade endless voyage for soil and sky.

Make a Settlement to conclude the situation.

sections.zh:
兵变发动中
没有可以接受的合约。

永恒巡游已经结束，发动兵变的船员已经夺取了舰桥。

改革政体，以结束此局势。
sections.en:
Ongoing Mutiny
No contracts can be accepted.

The Forever Cruise is gone and mutineers have seized the bridge.

Reform the government to conclude the situation.
